description: Web search via DuckDuckGo's public HTML results page: ranked titles, direct result URLs and snippets, no ads. No relevance score (DuckDuckGo does not publish one). DuckDuckGo often answers with an empty page; the tool retries, and if it still gets none the list is empty and 'note' says so. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: agent_intel_web_search_turbo
title: Agent Intel Web Search Turbo
